text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Still-san, come at me! With our futures on 
the line!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
If you, too, can see tomorrow reflected in 
the corner of your eyes!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Groove-san... No—Admire Groove!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!! Taaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: This is... the end of it...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...No. It's not over yet.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Before, part of me thought that way too. 
That "it doesn't matter whenever it ends."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yet it didn't end. Even for me, who had 
completely closed off her heart... a 
turning point arrived.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Running for someone else's sake. The one 
who first showed me that strength—was you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Groove-san...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I'll say it once more. It's not over. Not 
for me, not for you, not for us."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"This time, I'll show you. As long as you 
keep running, the road will always lead 
somewhere."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: There has to be a path... somewhere...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I... suppose so. If only that were true...

The clash between the two was as fierce as 
ever. Yet once they finished running, a 
certain calm settled over them.

—After the post-race events had settled 
down.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Um, Alv-senpai. I'm sorry to bother you 
when you're tired, but...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—Without further ado. With so many 
opponents you're facing for the first 
time, we'd like to ask how you formulated 
your strategy...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...You're right. I had a feeling you'd 
say that."

A barrage of questions after the race. 
Every single stroke of the pen will lead 
toward the future.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I see, thank you very much. I understand 
the details now, but nothing's coming to 
mind yet.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
If it were me... how would I have run in 
this situation?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
How did I run, you ask...? Are you already 
envisioning a Senior-tier GⅠ run right 
now?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I am also debuting this year. If it 
is a realm I will eventually reach, it is 
only natural to prepare for it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ………… This girl is...
choice_data_list:
Your future... holds way too much 
promise...
Your future... is way too promising...

text_block_list.text:
I knew her abilities were remarkable. But 
on top of that, she possesses a lofty 
perspective that looks far into the 
future...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list: I want to be there to see that day...
I'd love to see that day come...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. I shall see it through to 
the end, but...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Feel free to do as you please.

Her usual blunt attitude feels strangely 
comforting, too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (My future is—right here. And—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(I always want to be a role model for her. 
To show her an even higher ideal—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"This autumn—I would like to strive for an 
achievement that will carve my name into 
history."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: The ultimate goal in sight is—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"The Queen Elizabeth II Cup. In other 
words—"

Winning the Queen Elizabeth II Cup just 
once isn't enough to etch one's name in 
history. However...

Defending the title would be a completely 
different story. Combined with her 
achievements in the Triple Tiara, it would 
be a monumental feat.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Considering the Queen Elizabeth II Cup is 
our ultimate goal, the next race to choose 
would be...

I think to myself. A race that fits the 
schedule well and is worth challenging 
would be...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —That's quite a hurdle.

A 2000m GⅠ. A prestigious race where only 
the truly elite gather.

A strong result here should give us 
tremendous momentum.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Then it's settled. From the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) to the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: How strange... isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Races I want to run, things I want to 
convey. That is...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
To think it brings so much vitality to my 
everyday life...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I intend to do my best. Never again... 
will I...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —So that we won't lose our way.
